record.question: Who is the author of ‘A Fly on the Wheel: How I Helped Govern India”?
record.explanation: Answer A: T.H. Lewin. The author is Thomas Herbert Lewin (T. H. Lewin), not R. B. McCabe. The full book title is “A Fly on the Wheel; Or, How I Helped to Govern India”; the question shortens the subtitle, but the intended title and author are identifiable. Reference: https://books.google.com/books/about/A_Fly_on_the_Wheel_Or_How_I_Helped_to_Go.html?id=DHtCAAAAIAAJ; https://openlibrary.org/books/OL4390347M/A_fly_on_the_wheel. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: LDC MPSC Paper-I, February 2025 examination; current affairs interpreted as of paper date.. Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
